units.source_text: 此时源氏公子正在宫中，便将此事奏闻。

en.t: At this time Prince Genji was in the palace, so he reported the matter to the Emperor.

units.source_text: 皇上看了诗笑道：“他得意洋洋呢！”

en.t: After reading the poem, the Emperor laughed and said, "He is quite pleased with himself!"

units.source_text: 又说：“他特地派人来接，你该早些去。

en.t: He added, "Since he has specially sent someone to escort you, you should go early.

units.source_text: 公主们都在他家长大，他不会把你当作外人看待。”

en.t: The princesses all grew up in his household, so he will not treat you as an outsider."
